title: Waving
description: Makes Leaves, Flowers, Grass, & Water Wavey (Vanilla Minecraft Only)
body:
# Waving (Resource Pack) – Bring Life to Your World (Java Edition)
Waving is a lightweight vanilla-style resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition that makes Leaves, Flowers, Grass, and Water wave gently — giving your world a calm and natural movement effect. It keeps the original Minecraft textures and only adds animation, making your gameplay feel beautiful and more alive.

## ✨ Features
1.  Wavey Leaves on all trees
1.  Soft movement for Grass & Tall Grass
1.  Subtle animation on Flowers
1.  Calm wave effect on Water
1.  100% vanilla look preserved
1.  Works without shaders
1.  FPS-friendly on most systems
## ⚠️ Compatibility Notice
This pack does not work on:

• Not Supported / Reason

**Sodium**	Replaces block rendering / lacks wavey animation support

**OptiFine**	Conflicts with custom vertex animation method

✅ Works best on pure Vanilla Java or with clients/mod loaders that do not override block animations.

✅ Works in both singleplayer & multiplayer (client-side only)

**❌ Does not work on Bedrock / MCPE**

## ✅ Performance
The pack is very lightweight as it only animates existing vanilla textures — no models or high-res files. If your system can run vanilla, it can run this.
